ttea.games.kartea

KarTEA exergame of the T-TEA console.

The player drives a car along a pseudo-3D road by moving the feet in front of the camera, collecting targets and avoiding obstacles.

The game has two sides:

  • the configuration screens (PySide6, MVC): model, dao, service, controller, view, factory and the generated ui;

  • the game itself (pygame), started by main: gamecontroller, gamecore, gamemodel, gameview, gameui, gameutil and gametheme.

util holds the paths, defaults and resource fields shared by both.

Modules

controller

Controllers of the Kartea game register screens.

dao

Data access objects (DAOs) of the Kartea game.

factory

View factory of the Kartea game.

gamecontroller

Game controllers of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

gamecore

Core input of the KarTEA game: camera, pose tracking and lanes.

gamemodel

Game models of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

gametheme

Themes of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

gameui

UI helpers of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

gameutil

Utilities of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

gameview

Game views of the KarTEA game (pygame side).

main

Entry point of the KarTEA exergame (pygame side).

model

Data models of the Kartea game.

service

Service classes (MVCS) of the Kartea game.

util

Utilities of the Kartea game.

view

Views (Qt dialogs) of the Kartea game register screens.
